      • getQueue

@Nullable IQueue getQueue(@NotNull
                                     @NotNull java.util.UUID queueId)
        Get a IQueue by its associated UUID. If none is found, it returns null. The queue ID can be found in the IKit class.
        Parameters:
        queueId - The UUID of the queue to retrieve.
        Returns:
        IQueue or null if none is found.

      • joinQueue

        boolean joinQueue(@NotNull
                  @NotNull org.bukkit.entity.Player target,
                  @NotNull
                  @NotNull IKit kit,
                  @NotNull
                  @NotNull QueueType type)
        Force a player into a specific queue. There are certain checks that must be passed for a player to be successfully queued, otherwise this method will return false. Here are the checks:
        • The player must not already be in a queue.
        • The kit must be enabled.
        • If the queue type is ranked, the kit must support ranked queues.
        • If the queue type is unranked, the kit must support unranked queues.
        • The player must be in lobby state, see IProfile.isInLobby().
        • The player should pass network core checks like freeze, vanish, staff mode, comp ban.
        • If the player is in a party, they must be the leader and the party should only have one other member.
        Parameters:
        target - The player to be queued.
        kit - The kit associated with the queue.
        type - The type of queue (e.g., ranked, unranked).
        Returns:
        True if the player was successfully queued, false otherwise.

      • leaveQueue

        boolean leaveQueue(@NotNull
                   @NotNull org.bukkit.entity.Player target)
        Force a player to leave their current queue, if they are in one. If the player is not in a queue, this method will return false.
        Parameters:
        target - The player to be removed from their queue.
        Returns:
        True if the player was successfully removed from their queue, false otherwise.
